traits.name: Stench
traits.text: A creature that comes within 30 feet of the xulgath and can smell the xulgath must attempt a DC 19 Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature takes a –1 status penalty to all checks and DCs until it uses an action to retch. A creature that succeeds at its save isn't affected by any xulgaths' stenches for 1 minute.

traits.name: Melee Strike
traits.text: ⬻ (sweep); Damage 1d10+6 (1d10+6) slashing Melee Strike ⬻ jaws +11, Damage 1d6+6 (1d6+6) piercing Melee Strike ⬻ claw +11 (agile), Damage 1d4+6 (1d4+6) slashing

traits.name: Swipe
traits.text: ⬺ The xulgath boss makes two Strikes with their greataxe against two adjacent foes, both of whom are within their reach, with a +1 circumstance bonus. The second attack uses the same multiple attack penalty as the first, but attacks the xulgath boss makes after this take a –10 multiple attack penalty (or a –8 multiple attack penalty for its claw).
